title: Freestanding Paper Towel Holder 18-Inch Solid Brass Weighted Base for Countertop Allied Brass
description:
Upgrade countertop organization with a freestanding paper towel holder made from solid brass with an 18-inch height and a stable weighted base. No wall mounting is needed, making it an easy fit for kitchens, pantries, or anywhere you want quick access to a paper towel roll. The traditional design complements traditional bathroom hardware looks and coordinates well with classic bath accessories and heritage bathroom fixtures styling.

Highlights:
- Freestanding countertop paper towel holder; no wall mount required
- Solid brass construction with a solid brass weighted base to help prevent tipping
- Felt pad helps protect surfaces from scratches
- Available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes, including statement colors
- Designer finish provides corrosion-free and rust-free performance

Specs:
- Material: Brass
- Style: Traditional
- Dimensions: 5.5 in (L) x 5.5 in (W) x 18 in (H)
- Weight: 4.8 lb
- Assembly required: No
- Included items: Paper towel holder
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
